description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'DeviceConfiguratorPanel' that provides a UI component for configuring device qualifiers in an Android development environment. It includes nested classes for editing various resource qualifiers, UI setup, and event handling.

classes.name: DeviceConfiguratorPanel
classes.description: An abstract Swing panel for configuring device qualifiers in Android UI preview, with nested classes for editing specific qualifiers.

classes.description: Abstract base class for qualifier editors, providing methods to get UI component, reset state, and apply changes.
